A high-fidelity iPhone app UI design mockup, full-screen portrait composition, flat product-design screenshot style (not a photo of a phone).

App: "TourWise" — a house-viewing decision assistant. Visual direction: "evidence board on warm paper". Warm paper background #F6F1E7 covering the whole screen, white cards #FFFFFF, ink text #2B2620, brass accent #B4762A, sage accent #6E7F5C. System sans-serif type.

Screen: "Export Credits" purchase sheet (consumable credits, NOT a subscription). Layout skeleton:
- Top: navigation bar with title "Export Credits" and a small close X on the right.
- A balance card: "Balance" label with a large tabular number "100" credits, a thin brass underline, small caption "Starter credits included".
- Two product cards stacked, each a white card with 14pt radius:
  - Card A: "110 Export Credits" — right-aligned price "$0.99", small caption "Stock up for many Verdict exports".
  - Card B: "210 Export Credits" — price "$1.99", small caption "Best value · twice the exports", with a small sage "Best value" pill.
- A short plain-language note block: "Credits never expire. Each export uses 1 credit. Exports are rendered on-device; nothing leaves your phone."
- Bottom: nothing else; the sheet ends after the note block.

Density: low. Calm, honest, no pressure tactics.
Avoid: subscription wording ("monthly", "plan", "auto-renew"), any "Restore Purchases" link or button, countdown timers, dark patterns, aggressive red, cold blue SaaS checkout look, dark mode.
